This is the repeat (fourth) bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail relating to FIR No. 202/2016 registered at Police Station Jaisinagar, District Sagar for commission of offence punishable under Sections 409, 420 and 467 of IPC.
Heard on IA Nos. 11739/2023, an application for taking additional documents on record.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been arrested on 24/02/2019 in connection with Crime No. 202/2016 registered at Police Station Jaisinagar, District Sagar for commission of offence punishable under Sections 409, 420 and 467 of the IPC.

Thereafter, the applicant moved an application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., which got registered as M.Cr.C. No.
11446/2019 and the said application was allowed by this Court, vide order dated 10/05/2019 subject to depositing Rs.2,11,481/- with the Bank within a period of one week and on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
However, due to financial constraint, the applicant could not deposit the defalcation amount within stipulated time period and he is in custody till today.
It is also submitted that the applicant's wife had also died on 14/04/2023 and during custody period of the applicant, the Bank seized all pending funds of the applicant amounting to Rs.1,35,000/-.

Under these circumstances, learned counsel for the applicant prays that looking to the financial crisis of the applicant coupled with the fact that his wife died on 14/04/2013, order dated 10/05/2019 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 11446/2019 be modified to the extent that condition regarding deposition of defalcated amount Rs.2,11,481/- be relaxed.
On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer for the State has formally opposed the contention raised by learned counsel for the applicant.

Looking to overall facts and peculiar circumstances of the case, IA No. 13799/2023 stands allowed and order dated 10/05/2019 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 11446/2019 is modified and applicant is directed to be released on bail subject to depositing balance defalcated amount amounting to Rs.76,000/- in place of Rs. 2,11,481/- within two weeks from today.
Rest terms and conditions of order dated 10/05/2019 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 11446/2019 shall remain intact.
This order shall be read conjointly with order dated 10/05/2019 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 11446/2019.
With the aforesaid observations, M.Cr.C. No. 17539/2023 stands disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.

(ARUN KUMAR SHARMA) JUDGE skt Umrao Ahirwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47091358/
